next_steps.action: The rail-voltage measurement was flagged INVALID (taken but unusable — e.g. loose probe contact, wrong range, or a non-numeric reading). No diagnostic conclusion can be trusted until the reading is re-taken. Re-measure the rail voltage carefully: correct range, solid probe contact, stable display.

measure.expected: A stable numeric reading (0.0 V or the nominal rail voltage).

interpretations.then: Re-run the diagnosis with the new reading.
